types.name: AnimationAsset
types.doc:
An imported glTF asset: skeleton, meshes, materials, decoded images, and
animation clips. Outputs are in model space (+Z up, +X forward, metres).
Every node of the glTF scene is a joint, so names match the source nodes.

fields.name: jointParents
fields.doc: Parent joint per joint, or -1 for roots; parents precede children.

fields.name: warnings
fields.doc: Non-fatal import diagnostics, such as unsupported features that were skipped.

fields.name: load
fields.doc: Loads a .gltf or .glb file; relative buffers and images resolve beside it.

fields.name: fromBytes
fields.doc: Loads a GLB, or a .gltf whose buffers and images are embedded data URIs.

fields.name: jointIndex
fields.doc: Returns the joint with this glTF node name, or -1.

fields.name: clipIndex
fields.doc:
Returns the clip with this exact name, or else the clip whose action name
matches ignoring case, or -1. Blender exports clips as "Armature|Action",
so "walk" finds "CharacterArmature|Walk".

fields.name: readIndices
fields.doc: Packed uint32 triangle indices.

fields.name: readTexcoords
fields.doc: Packed float32 UV pairs with glTF's top-left origin, or null when absent.

fields.name: readBindPositions
fields.doc: Float32 xyz positions in source bind space.

fields.name: readBindNormals
fields.doc: Float32 xyz normals in source bind space.

fields.name: readJointIndices
fields.doc: Uint16x4 palette indices per vertex; empty for rigid primitives.

fields.name: readJointWeights
fields.doc: Float32x4 weights per vertex; empty for rigid primitives.

fields.name: readSkinJoints
fields.doc: Int32 skeleton joints in palette order; owning joint for rigid primitives.

fields.name: readInverseBindMatrices
fields.doc: Column-major float32 4x4 inverse binds in palette order.

fields.name: readImage
fields.doc: Decoded RGBA8 pixels, top row first.

fields.name: dispose
fields.doc: Releases the asset; instances created from it stay valid.

types.name: AnimationInstance
types.doc:
One posed copy of an asset. Set up to four blend layers, evaluate, then read
the CPU-skinned vertex streams and joint matrices in model space.

fields.name: new
fields.doc: Creates an instance at the rest pose, already evaluated.

fields.name: setLayer
fields.doc:
Sets one blend layer. A layer contributes when clip is valid and weight is
positive; weights are normalized across layers. Time is in seconds and
wraps when loop is set, otherwise it clamps to the clip.

fields.name: setIk
fields.doc:
Sets one of MAX_IK_CHAINS two-bone chains solved after the layers blend:
end reaches target and mid points along pole, both [x, y, z] in scene
space (pole is a direction; a zero pole bends the limb the way the animation
does, which never flips as the target moves). Weight 0 disables the chain.

fields.name: setJointRotation
fields.doc:
Turns a joint by rotation ([x, y, z, w], about its own local axes) on top of its animated pose and
before inverse kinematics, so its children turn with it: fingers curl, a spine leans. Weight blends
from no turn (0, which removes it) to all of it (1). `source` names who asks: turns of different
sources on one joint compose, lowest source first, and never overwrite each other. The turn stays
until it is removed.

fields.name: clearJointRotation
fields.doc: Removes one source's turn from a joint.

fields.name: setJointRotations
fields.doc:
Replaces every turn of one source in a single call: joint i is turned by rotations[i] ([x, y, z, w])
at weights[i]. Turns of other sources stay. Nothing changes if any entry is invalid.

fields.name: clearJointRotations
fields.doc: Removes every turn of one source.

fields.name: clearIk
fields.doc: Disables one inverse kinematics chain.

fields.name: clearLayers
fields.doc: Clears every layer, returning the instance to the rest pose on evaluate.

fields.name: evaluatePose
fields.doc: Evaluates the pose and joint matrices only, without skinning; see ak_instance_evaluate_pose.

fields.name: evaluate
fields.doc: Samples, blends, and skins the current layers.

fields.name: readPositions
fields.doc: Deformed float32 xyz positions of one primitive.

fields.name: readNormals
fields.doc: Deformed unit float32 xyz normals of one primitive.

fields.name: readJointMatrices
fields.doc: One column-major float32 4x4 model matrix per joint, 64 bytes each.

fields.name: readSkinMatrices
fields.doc: Float32 column-major 4x4 matrices mapping bind vertices to model space, in palette order.

fields.name: bounds
fields.doc: Deformed bounds as [minX, minY, minZ, maxX, maxY, maxZ].

types.name: AssetMaterial
types.doc: glTF metallic-roughness material values AnimKit imports.

types.name: AssetPrimitive
types.doc: One drawable mesh primitive of an imported asset.

types.name: ClipPlayer
types.doc:
Plays one clip at a time on an instance and crossfades between clips.
The outgoing clips keep advancing while their weights fade to zero. One overlay clip may be mixed over
all of that at a weight the caller sets, to hold a pose such as a crouch at any depth between the two.

fields.name: speed
fields.doc: Playback rate multiplier applied to both clips.

fields.name: fadeWeight
fields.doc: How far the current clip has faded in, 0 to 1; one when nothing is fading.

fields.name: fading
fields.doc: Whether a crossfade between clips is still running.

fields.name: playNamed
fields.doc: Starts a clip by name; returns false when the asset has no such clip.

fields.name: play
fields.doc: Starts a clip from its beginning, fading from the current one. Replaying the current clip is a no-op.

fields.name: restart
fields.doc:
Starts a clip from its beginning with no fade, even when it is already the
current clip, dropping any crossfade in progress and returning the rate to
normal. This puts the player back as if the clip had just been started.

fields.name: setOverlay
fields.doc:
Mixes a clip over everything else at `weight` (0 none, 1 only the overlay), looping on its own clock. A
negative clip, or a weight of zero, takes it out of the mix; the clock keeps running, so putting the same
clip back picks up where it would be rather than from its start. With `hold` the overlay does not run but
stays at that time in the clip, which poses the body part way through a one-way clip. Takes effect from the
next advance.

fields.name: advance
fields.doc: Advances playback, updates the instance layers, and evaluates the pose.

fields.name: pose
fields.doc:
Like `advance`, but evaluates the pose only: joint matrices are current and the deformed geometry is not
touched. For measuring what a pose would be (planning a reach) without paying to skin it.

types.name: HumanBone
types.doc:
the standard humanoid bones. The finger bones name the knuckle at the
base of each finger's first segment. Asset rigs map onto these names once at
import, so everything above AnimKit is independent of any asset's naming.
The names describe anatomy only; an asset's own hierarchy may differ.

fields.name: ToeTipL
fields.doc: Tip of the left foot, where the toes end.

fields.name: REQUIRED
fields.doc: Bones every humanoid rig must provide.

fields.name: OPTIONAL
fields.doc: Bones used when present: spine segments, shoulders, toes, toe tips, and knuckles for hand frames.

types.name: HumanPose
types.doc:
Standard-bone view of an animation instance's joint matrices, in the
model's space (+Z up, +X forward, metres).

Hands expose a rig-independent frame: the origin is the palm centre, +X
points along the fingers, +Y towards the thumb side, and +Z completes a
right-handed frame, so it leaves the two hands through opposite faces. It is
derived from the rest pose knuckles, so grip offsets authored once work on
every rig. Other bones use their own joint frame with scale removed.

fields.name: new
fields.doc: restMatrices must be the instance's joint matrices at its rest pose.

fields.name: update
fields.doc: Replaces the pose with an instance's current joint matrices.

fields.name: bonePosition
fields.doc: Model-space position of a bone, or null when the rig lacks it.

fields.name: boneFrame
fields.doc: Rigid model-space frame of a bone, or null when the rig lacks it.

types.name: HumanoidRig
types.doc: An asset's joints resolved onto the standard humanoid bones.

fields.name: new
fields.doc: Resolves mapping against asset; throws when a required bone is missing.

fields.name: detect
fields.doc: Uses the first preset that provides every required bone.

fields.name: joint
fields.doc: The asset joint for a standard bone, or -1 when the rig lacks it.

types.name: Mat4
types.doc: Column-major 4x4 matrix helpers over Array<Float>, using column vectors.

fields.name: frame
fields.doc: A rigid frame from an origin and unit x and y axes; z completes a right-handed basis.

fields.name: rigidInverse
fields.doc: Inverse of a rigid transform (orthonormal rotation plus translation).

fields.name: orthonormalized
fields.doc:
Removes scale and shear, keeping the x axis direction and translation.
Exporters often bake unit scale (such as Mixamo's 0.01) into bones, which
rigid attachments must not inherit.

types.name: RigMapping
types.doc:
Names of an asset rig's joints for each standard bone. Joint names are
compared after dropping any namespace prefix ending in ':', so Mixamo's
"mixamorig:Hips" and "mixamorig1:Hips" both match "Hips". A bone may list
alternatives, used in order, for variants within one rig family.

fields.name: jointNames
fields.doc: The asset joint names that may provide a standard bone, preferred first.

fields.name: alternative
fields.doc: Adds a fallback joint name for a bone, tried after the ones already given.

fields.name: quaternius
fields.doc: Quaternius characters, including the Ultimate Modular and Universal Animation rigs.

fields.name: universal
fields.doc: Quaternius's Universal Animation Library character, whose joints are Blender "DEF-" deformation bones.

fields.name: mixamo
fields.doc: Mixamo exports, with or without the "mixamorig:" namespace.

fields.name: localName
fields.doc: Drops a namespace prefix such as "mixamorig:".
